title: Billing Error Disputes Under the Ridgeline Consumer Credit Cardholder Agreement
content:
**Cardholder agreement — billing errors (Ridgeline Consumer Credit).**

1. **Filing.** A billing error dispute is filed as a billing dispute request on the account that names the disputed purchase line and the disputed amount.
2. **Window.** It is accepted only when the dispute is filed no more than the tier's dispute window in calendar days after the statement on which the disputed charge first appeared was issued. The window is counted in calendar days from that statement's date as day 0; a dispute filed on the last day of the window is timely, and one filed later is not accepted.
3. **While open.** The dispute is acknowledged within the tier's acknowledgement period and resolved within the tier's maximum resolution period, both counted from filing. While it is open the disputed amount is left out of the minimum payment, accrues no interest and cannot make the account delinquent, and the undisputed balance must still be paid.
4. **Dispute credit.** A dispute credit posts only when the billing dispute request has status approved. It credits the disputed amount plus any interest charged on it, references the purchase and the request, and fees caused solely by the disputed amount are reversed separately as fee corrections.
5. **Declined.** When the request is declined no credit posts and the amount re-enters the next statement.
6. **Limits.** Only the part of a charge not already credited by a return credit can be disputed, and one purchase receives at most one dispute credit.

## Window boundary (hypothetical statement dated 5 June, 60-day window)

| Filed on | Day count from 5 June | Accepted |
|---|---|---|
| 4 August | day 60 | yes (last day) |
| 5 August | day 61 | no |
| 20 June | day 15 | yes |

## Partly credited charge (hypothetical)

A 700.00 purchase already credited 200.00 by a return credit: at most 500.00 of it can be disputed. If the dispute is approved, the credit is that disputed amount plus the interest charged on it; a second dispute credit on the same purchase is not posted.
